svg.text: Is ar scáth a chéile a mhaireann na daoine
Sources: General Scheme, Irish Nationality and Citizenship (Amendment) Bill 2026, Heads 5, 6, 9; Act of 1956 ss. 15, 15A; ISD reckonable residence rules
new clock does not run on this permission
Bars run to the first date an application may be made. A decision is at the Minister’s discretion, and processing time sits on top.
